headline: The Falconeer Revolution Remaster hits consoles December 2
title: The Falconeer | Remaster Hits PS5 and Xbox Dec 2 | Gaming News
video_script: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S on December second, twenty twenty six. It is a game about flying a warbird over a stormy ocean world. The remaster is nineteen ninety nine dollars, and owners of the original can upgrade from two ninety nine. Wired Productions publishes it and Tomas Sala made it. Ready to take flight? Comment below!
description: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S on December 2, 2026, published by Wired Productions. Sources: Gematsu, Gaming Trend, PlayStation Store.
joke: Flying is easy, landing on a tiny rock in a storm is the real quest.
